subject: rt-dy
title: RT.DY.------SOC.RT.INT.
description: Chart on book p. 421 (MID-W-15). RT-DY (reality dynamics) is the subject; SOC-RT-INT (social reality interpretation) is the partner. From the subject: VT-PLT (vibrational platform) and POL-DY (political dynamics). From VT-PLT: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: ACT (activism). From ACT: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From POL-DY: MOT-DY. From MOT-DY: T-L (time lag), V-SY (value system) and AFTD (affinity tendencies). From T-L: RE-DOC (redocumentation), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
